name: Question 9
problem: Find all of the subsets of $P={10,20}.$
worked_solution:
To find every subset of $P,$ we list out every combination of elements within $P.$ 

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14038640/assets/17d796ca9f78e72d15b6f29565d03a5ea42c1e2fe544acd02bc3f368993cdb9c.png)

Note that we must include the empty set, since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{10},{20},{10,20}.
$$
